name: build-toolchain
body: The pinned set of compilers and toolchains used to build and stage the release artifacts. Rust is exact on every path (root `rust-toolchain.toml`, `channel = 1.98.1`); Node is build-enforced (`src/tslib/.npmrc engine-strict`); Go is exact on the release Linux path (`GOTOOLCHAIN` + `actions/setup-go`) with a documented floor (`src/golib/go.mod` `toolchain go1.27.1`) on the bottle/ambient path; JDK 21 and .NET 10.0.x are pinned in CI. Pinning the set makes a release reproducible.
